card.name: Voting rights and turnout contexts
card.fires_on: Spots in text about voting, suffrage or disenfranchisement where the next word is likely about voting. It often marks a space or number piece after 'vote until' or 'turnout reached a record', or the middle of 'disenfranchisement' and 'suffrage'.

modes.label: Dates and numbers
modes.description: A space or digit piece in a year or percentage inside a passage about who could vote or turnout.

modes.label: Inside suffrage words
modes.description: Partway through words like disenfranchisement or suffrage.

modes.label: Linking word before vote
modes.description: A small word just before the verb vote.
modes.example: remember to tell your students<< to>> vote."

card.writes: It pushes the model toward vote, voting and voter words as the next text.
card.plain: It lights up in election and voting-rights writing when a word about voting is likely to come next.
